flagged.evidence: The page says it “obtains every phi action (including the value at zero) from one augmented exponential.” The definition includes k≥0 and identifies φ₀(X) with the exponential, but the augmented-action theorem defines Bₖ and proves that identity only for k≥1; the Arnoldi algorithm handles k=0 by calling the scaled Taylor routine directly on the reduced exponential action. The current results therefore do not establish that every action in the stated family comes from an augmented exponential.
